verses.id: Demi matahari dan sinarnya pada pagi hari
verses.en: By the sun and its brightness
And [by] the moon when it follows it
And [by] the day when it displays it
And [by] the night when it covers it
And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
And [by] the earth and He who spread it
And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

verses.id: maka Dia mengilhamkan kepadanya (jalan) kejahatan dan ketakwaannya
verses.en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness

verses.id: sungguh beruntung orang yang menyucikannya (jiwa itu)
verses.en: He has succeeded who purifies it

verses.id: dan sungguh rugi orang yang mengotorinya
verses.en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]

verses.id: (Kaum) Samud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas (zalim)
verses.en: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression

verses.id: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka
verses.en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
verses.tr: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha
verses.id: lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka, "(Biarkanlah) unta betina dari Allah ini dengan minumannya
verses.en: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.tr: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha
verses.id: Namun mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelihnya, karena itu Tuhan membinasakan mereka karena dosanya, lalu diratakan-Nya (dengan tanah)
verses.en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]

verses.id: Dan Dia tidak takut terhadap akibatnya
verses.en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof
